FC-2.text: No layout fits: data centres are not permitted at grade in FC-2 (FC-2 District Schedule, October 2026, s. 2.2.4).

about: Lot -> best library layout (one MW source per lot). Key = lot id of the coverage file (City of Vancouver property-tax roll id; no licensed property records (local only) values). There is no single best layout: it depends on the filter. byDensity gives, per storey band (1-3, 4+), the fitting layout with the most MW (ties: fits more lots, then fewer storeys) and up to 3 alternatives; best / alternatives repeat the 1-3 band (4+ where the lot has nothing in 1-3) for readers that do not filter yet. totals: lots reached and summed lot MW per band and for both bands together; its MW, storey-1 footprint, storeys, outdoor generators and yard come from the library export. "no layout fits" = the Engineering cards keep their own sizing, labelled "rough size, no layout fits this lot". Generated by from the live kept set; regenerate after every rebuild. Lots the rebuilt library does not cover keep their earlier layout.
